results.description:
Find your way with Mapy.com’s maps no matter where you are: hiking on small forest paths, biking in mountains and even without a signal.

Mapy.com is an outdoor route planner with tracker and navigation that works also offline with GPS. New features include peak recognition or location sharing that should help you enjoy your trail to the max.

-	Maps of the whole world: outdoor, aerial, winter
-	Local POIs, tips for trips and category search
-	Easy to use route planner with many planning options
-	Hiking, mtb or road bike supported
-	Outdoor step-by-step navigation with GPS
-	Distance tracker for many outdoor activities
-	Location sharing with friend or family

Route planner

-	A to B or round route planning
-	Many options for hiking or biking
-	Route information: estimated time, distance, elevation

Choose your style and plan the route exactly to your needs, whatever activity you want to do. Mapy.com’s route planner has multiple options for both walking and biking – and when the snow falls, you can also plan with cross-country ski or skialp.

Display the information for your route and find out the distance, elevation, or time estimation. If you are an advanced user, you’ll appreciate the settings of your own speed or the slope shading that completes the elevation profile overview.

GPS Maps and navigation

-	Location on the map with GPS turned on
-	Step-by-step outdoor navigation

You always know where you are with Mapy.com. Your GPS location is displayed directly on the map, and you can find the way to your destination from there with navigation. You can also turn on the voice navigation available in 10 languages.

Offline maps

-	For places without connection
-	Saving data and battery
-	Download one region or whole countries

Device is offline? No problem, offline maps save the day. Small mountain paths or deep forest without connection, you will find the way. Just be sure to download the region before you go.

Tracker

-	Performance recording for many outdoor activities
-	Travelled distance, speed and time tracking

Track your trails and save your progress. Know your pace, travelled distance or elevation for each of your activities. Tracker helps you have overview of your adventures and can be used also on Apple Watch.

Location sharing

-	Location of your loved ones on the map

Know where your friends and family are: turn on the location sharing and display their portraits on the map. Always find each other when someone gets delayed by the nice view or stay in the alpine hut longer.

Horizont AR

-	Peak recognition
-	Height or distance information

Find out the name, height or distance from you for each hill or mountain before you with augmented reality. No more arguing if that peak is Ben Lomond, Mont Blanc or Everest. Enjoy your views and save screens directly to your phone, keeping track of your trails.

My Mapy

-	Space for saving your plans
-	Activity history
-	User reviews and photos

Save your planned routes, tracked activities or places you’d like to visit. Create a long-distance trail stage by stage for your bike- or backpacking adventure. Set your average speed for more accurate travelling time estimations.

Mapy Premium

-	Premium features like Horizont AR or Apple Watch
-	Offline maps without limits
-	Advanced route planning
-	Custom speed settings

Mapy.com has a subscription option for users that wish for more customized experience. Plan according to your preferences, get more accurate time estimations, and download more than one country’s offline map.

Apple Watch

-	Mapy.com on watch for subscribed users
-	Maps, tracker and navigation

TIPS AND RECOMMENDATIONS:

-	You need internet connection to download offline maps 
-	Enable location services in your phone settings
-	Enable background location access to share your location
